report.Title: Password Length Requirement Not Met During Account Creation
report.Summary: The account creation process failed due to a password not meeting the minimum length requirement.
Steps: Navigate to the 'Create account' page.
Enter 'dev@example.com' in the 'Email' field.
Enter a password with fewer than 12 characters in the 'Password' field.
Click the 'Create account' button.
Observe the error message: 'Password must contain at least 12 characters.'

matched_facts: Password must contain at least 12 characters

report.Title: Duplicate Payment Submission Triggered
report.Summary: The system incorrectly processes a duplicate payment submission, generating two invoices upon attempting to place an order.
Steps: On the 'Review order' page, click the 'Place order' button.
Observe that two invoices (#4812 and #4813) appear, both marked as 'Processing', and a red error message 'Payment submitted twice' is displayed.

report.Title: Action Buttons Overflow Mobile Viewport
report.Summary: The 'Delete' button overlaps the mobile viewport, causing partial visibility.
Steps: Open the mobile profile page in Chrome on macOS (Darwin).
Observe the profile section with 'Message' and 'Edit' buttons initially visible.
An additional 'Delete' button appears and partially overflows the viewport.

missing_facts: Action buttons overflow the mobile viewport

report.Title: Loader Stuck on Account Overview
report.Summary: The loader on the 'Account overview' page remains stuck and does not progress to load workspace details.
Steps: Open the 'Account overview' page in the application.
Observe the loading screen displaying 'Loading account... Fetching workspace details'.
After 2 minutes, the screen changes to 'Still loading after 2 minutes. Workspace details never appeared'.

report.Title: 404 Error on Billing Navigation
report.Summary: Navigating to billing settings results in a 404 error.
Steps: Open the application in a Chrome browser on macOS.
Navigate to the 'Billing settings' page.
Observe the page transitions to a '404 Page not found' error with the message 'The path /settings/billing could not be found.'

report.Title: Incorrect card number format validation
report.Summary: The application does not properly validate the card number input, allowing a reduced number of digits without feedback before a manual interaction.
Steps: Navigate to the checkout page 'Northstar'.
Observe the card number input field pre-filled with '4242 4242 4242 4242'.
Manually delete some digits from the card number input field ('4242 4242').
Notice the error message: 'Card number must contain 16 digits' is displayed.

report.Title: Contrast Issue with API Credential Warning Text
report.Summary: The warning text about the API key's inadequate contrast is not visible on the dark card background.
Steps: Access the 'Developer settings' page on Northstar.
Observe the 'API credentials' section.
Note the warning: 'The key warning text has insufficient contrast against the dark card.'

report.Title: Stale Status Count in Header Badge
report.Summary: The header badge displays an outdated count of open incidents, showing '12 open' despite all incidents being resolved in the main content.
Steps: Observe in Frame 1 that the header badge shows '12 open' incidents while the main content states '12 incidents require attention'.
Observe in Frame 2 that the main content updates to '0 active incidents', indicating all incidents were resolved, but the header badge still displays '12 open'.

report.Title: Upload Progress Stuck at 73%
report.Summary: The upload process for the file 'checkout-bug.webm' pauses at 73%, with a note indicating 'No progress for 5 minutes'.
Steps: Start an upload for the file 'checkout-bug.webm'.
Observe the upload progress reaching 73%.
Note the message 'No progress for 5 minutes' appears below the progress bar.

report.Title: Member Email Clipping Issue in Workspace Members Table
report.Summary: The email address in the 'Email' column of the Workspace Members table is clipped and unreadable when it is too long.
Steps: Open the application to the Workspace Members page where user details are displayed.
Observe that in Frame 2, the email in the 'Email' column is clipped and an error message 'Member email is clipped and cannot be read' is visible.
Trigger unknown from provided frames.
